reviews.text: Staff are lovely and very professional they love what they do and it shows, very helpful.

We joined this practice last year. We have a dog. The staff are all very friendly. Big shout out to the receptionist who gives our dog treats. She is so friendly and welcoming. You can tell she just loves her job and animals.
The vet we saw was very friendly and so professional. They are very reasonably priced.i would definitely recommend this practice
Had to leave this practice and use another vet, staff were lovely but the owner was rude and condescending, I’ll never use this vet again..
First class service, you can tell they're passionate about the welfare of the animals
Great staff and first class service. Been coming here with my 3 dogs I've owned and excellent care
Carol and the vet team always so kind and caring. Rachel and India on reception are always very helpful.
Brilliant vetinary practice Very friendly staff.

I had need to have my older cat seen quite quickly by a vet and was given an appointment for early next morning which I was very pleased about.
I was quite worried about my cat needing sedation at 15+yrs and I thought the worst could happen. Maybe cat is an indoor ragdoll cat and very nervous and does not like being stroked or handled by anyone including myself. Well all my fears were for her were unnecessary as yhe Vet we saw [Jenny] was absolutely brilliant with her. So spoke quietly and calmly and my cat was thee calmest she has been in any vet surgery anywhere.  The cat was sedated and treated and back home with us in 2hours.
I can not thank the Vet enough wonderful service indeed.
However
Lovely staff and great and knowledgeable about all aspects of animals.

This is a lovely vets the receptionist is happy and friendly. The vets are lovely. I'm new to the area having moved up from Cambridge, I still can't believe I  pay 1/2the cost of appointments and medication  up here

Fabulous staff who take great care & attention of the animals & their humans. The owner, Carol, takes time to explain diagnosis & treatment options & has instilled strong values & a great sense of family with her team. So glad I changed.
Great service
Craigpark is a fantastic vets with a lovely staff team. They take so much care and attention. Wouldn't go anywhere else!

This is a well known in the area, vet practice. I understand they specialise in small animals, or domestic pets. Currently, there is an extended wait of at least a week for ‘routine’ appointments. So if you need a routine injection or annual vaccination get it booked in plenty of time. Urgent care is a discussion with the reception desk. As a vet I’m certain they don’t want animals to suffer, so
the odd emergency appointment should be available.
I’ve been a customer for 36 years and have no complaints.
Staff are friendly, helpful and have cared for my various cats over the years.
They have even helped with coordination between treatment and insurance companies for payment. In some cases submitting the claim for me.
Great Veterinary Practice

Take very good care of the pets and have good knowledge on pets very efficient at there jobs and take little to no time at all. They also have an assortment of different foods and toys or care items for your pets would highly recommend going to see them as they are very professional. :))

Marley became acquainted with staff on 13th January. He behaved, probably because he was unwell. Marley was thoroughly examined, given a diagnosis, sent home with meds and after a week is back to full health & his usual mischievous antics.
We cannot praise everyone highly enough. I have had to use numerous vets in my life. Carol Dobson is top drawer. The interaction with us & Marley was professional, knowledgeable , & friendly.
Best wishes to you all

Marley
Can't fault the service my dog got
Outstanding service and care, they are very thorough and attentive with my cats

Amazing vets. Very easy to sign up and the pet plan is great value.
Taking care of our older cats and our kitten.

Took my cat in today in such short notice & managed to fit him in, couldn’t have been happier with the outcome. Receptionist & vet nurse were lovely & so understanding & kept me & my cat at ease. Reasonably priced also and i definitely wouldn’t go anywhere else.
Been going here for many years.  Always a great service and friendly staff.  Would recommend.
Nice, friendly practice. Always try their best to fit you in. Receptionist very friendly, always ready to give Jack, our labrador, a treat for sitting nicely on the scales!

Really disappointed was told my appointment was half 8 I showed up at 8:32 to be told to go back outside as they open at 8:30 felt strange straight away. Then they told me I was told all the wrong information. Was meant to be £87 for neutering I went here instead of my normal vet due to their competitive rate but whoever can't do their job right left out VAT so it was actually almost £100 and I was told I'd need to wait to speak with the vet who doesn't show up for 1 hour. I took time off work. I was on time. It cost me petrol. I was prepared. This place was not. Wouldn't go near this place again. Just disappointed.
Excellent facilities, staff are great. Very accommodating with appointments. Particularly good vets for those with sighthounds like greyhounds.

Great vet practice, so helpful and offer services actively. A refreshing change from previous practices i have used.

Highly Recommended..

Been attending this vet with various animals for over 18 year, now have a young dog who is over 78kg, with a long term skin condition.  The team here are amazing, know exactly how to handle her, giving her the best medical and caring attention, they thrive to go the extra mile, even clear the waiting room temporarily whilst she gets weighed, would recommend this vet to all and would not go anywhere else.

Had to take my mums dog in as an emergency as she collapsed and wouldn't stand. The vet was extremely busy with other animal patients yet everyone was happy for my mum and Maisie to be more or less taken straight in. They couldn't of been …
Very friendly staff.
Always looking after your pets
Great vet have been a client here for over 30yrs carol and her staff are wonderful
